concepts.name: 孔版游记
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Create ONE complete landscape 16:9 high fidelity art-direction concept board for the cozy birdwatching and rare-event collection game "Little Elsewhere". The supplied screenshot is a composition reference only: preserve the inside-window viewpoint, large tree at left, windowsill plants and bird feeder, curved river and opposite town, distant snowy mountains. Completely redesign the interface and unify the whole illustration into this artistic language. Remove absolutely all of the source image's bottom dark-green developer toolbar.
DIRECTION 17: RISO RAMBLE. Extremely recognizable handmade risograph art, only cream paper, dark fir-green ink and dusty burnt-terracotta ink. Visible offset registration, coarse stipple and halftone, uneven hand-carved botanical and bird silhouettes, rough torn-paper ticket-shaped controls, ink stamps, large playful cut-letter typography. Never a generic rectangle UI with a color swap. UI silhouettes must feel printed, cut and collaged, including leaf-shaped bookmarks, a bird-shaped collected badge, perforated observation tickets and a ragged open field notebook.
Composition: left approximately 70 percent is a full in-game window HUD with artistic controls hugging the edges and the river/mountain view left airy in the middle. Title "Little Elsewhere" at upper left, small printed weather glyph at upper right, sparse lower actions "Observe", "Focus", collection "12/50". Right approximately 30 percent is a beautiful matching opened "Field Guide" with a "Sparrow" printed bird card, other tiny specimen stamps, short ruled notes and a hand-stamped completion seal. The right and left areas form one designed illustrated presentation, not a webpage grid.
Use a few exact short English labels only: "Little Elsewhere", "Field Guide", "Sparrow", "Observe", "Focus", "12/50". Avoid dense fine print. Strong crafted visual personality, restrained low saturation, dry flat printed texture, no glossy or oily rendering, no neon, no photoreal 3D plastic, no business dashboard, no ordinary rounded rectangles. High finish, legible main labels.
concepts.review: Visual inspection passed: strongly distinct material/shape language, correct title and key labels, no source debug toolbar.

concepts.name: 铅笔野录
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Produce ONE polished landscape 16:9 illustration-based UI art direction board for a calm birdwatching, landscape and rare-event collection game "Little Elsewhere". Input screenshot is only a geographic composition reference: view out a window, large tree and birds on left, indoor windowsill with plants and feeder, curving river, opposite village, far snowy mountains. Replace all existing interface elements and typography, and completely remove the source screenshot's bottom dark-green developer toolbar.
DIRECTION 18: GRAPHITE FIELDWORK. Make the entire proposed interface emphatically hand drawn in real soft graphite pencil on warm grey-white sketchbook paper, with scratchy contours, crosshatching, eraser rubs, pencil smudges, loose double outlines, binder holes, tiny metal paper clips, taped leaf specimens and rough hand-lettered tabs. Only ONE very restrained sage-green accent color, otherwise graphite and paper. This is a confident artist's naturalist sketchbook, not smooth vector UI, not beige rectangles with an illustrated sticker. UI buttons are circled handwritten words on irregular torn slips, counters drawn inside a bird-shaped pencil outline, weather symbols as quick pencil doodles. Large expressive but legible hand lettering.
Composition: left about 70 percent is a fully composed game HUD with the reference landscape redrawn as atmospheric pencil sketch, preserving the river bends and mountain silhouette. UI along the edges leaves the middle view quiet. A title slip at top left says "Little Elsewhere"; lower controls "Observe", "Focus" and "12/50" integrated into sketchbook margins. Right about 30 percent is an open vertical field notebook with punched page holes, titled "Field Guide", a detailed accurate sparrow pencil study labeled "Sparrow", a wing study, a pressed sage leaf, and a few light hand-ruled blank observation lines. Make the notebook binding and paper contour real and distinctive.
Sparse exact English text only: "Little Elsewhere", "Field Guide", "Sparrow", "Observe", "Focus", "12/50". No decorative gibberish or dense fine print. Keep pencil texture visible at viewing size. Strong expressive art direction, soothing and airy; no photographic notebook mockup, no oil painting, no glossy rendering, no business software dashboard, no neon or saturated palette.

concepts.name: 深夜讯号
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Create ONE complete high-quality landscape 16:9 UI art-direction concept board for the cozy birdwatching and rare-sky-event game "Little Elsewhere". The reference image only supplies the geography: inside a window, a large tree and small birds on left, plants and a feeder on the sill, a curved river and village on its far bank, snowy mountains. Completely replace its interfaces, typography and all panels; do NOT retain its bottom dark-green developer toolbar.
DIRECTION 19: NIGHT SIGNAL. A lovingly hand-painted, two-dimensional 1980s field-observation instrument and compact cassette recorder interface. Dominant black-olive enamel, warm muted amber phosphor, aged cream labels. Really distinctive hardware silhouettes: stepped casing corners, ribbed speaker strip, tactile square keycaps, chunky rotary dial, metal calibration marks, narrow glowing dot-matrix readouts, tiny pixel bird symbols, cassette drawers used as collection tabs. Keep it cozy and low-key, NOT neon cyberpunk, NOT slick futuristic HUD, NOT glossy photoreal 3D hardware. Use flat pixel-assisted illustrated enamel and softly worn edges.
Composition: left approximately 70 percent contains the in-game window view, now a calm dusk-to-night scene framed by the field-recorder casing. Retain the curved river, left tree, feeder and mountain relationships. Sparse amber pixel stars and a few town-window lights, wide readable view in the middle, no opaque menus covering the landscape. Title display "Little Elsewhere" on the upper bezel; weather shown with a small amber dot-matrix moon glyph. Lower hardware panel has two large distinctive keycaps labeled "Observe" and "Focus", a collection counter "12/50", a real-looking drawn rotary volume dial and tiny VU marks.
Right approximately 30 percent is the matching "Field Guide" as a vertically opened cassette-data archive: a cream-and-amber sparrow specimen card labeled "Sparrow" in a raster display, two small cassette-shaped specimen tabs and an illustrated wing-frequency plot. Keep all scientific-looking marks decorative, uncluttered, not a generic software dashboard.
Only exact short English labels "Little Elsewhere", "Field Guide", "Sparrow", "Observe", "Focus", "12/50". Strong stylization and genuinely redesigned ornamental controls, not a palette swap on rounded rectangles. Handcrafted illustrated concept art with clear readable major text, restrained color and convincing retro instrument character.
concepts.review: Visual inspection passed: strongly distinct material/shape language, correct title and key labels, no source debug toolbar.
